description: Name lookup order: Local, Enclosing, Global, Built-in.
Raised when a function assigns to a name (making it local) and reads it before the assignment.
Declares that an assignment targets a variable of an enclosing function instead of creating a local.
Declares that an assignment targets a module-level name. Avoid it for mutable state.
Python creates scopes for functions, classes, comprehensions and modules, not for `if`, `for` or `while` blocks.
